newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email sees 2nd half rise on year ago.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email sees 2nd half rise on year ago.

text.p: Appliance and building products manufacturer Email Ltd said on Monday that it expected second half pre-tax profits to be higher than in the second half of the 1995/96 year to March 31.
"We are expecting in the second half that we would have pre-tax operating profits higher than last year," managing director John Hanna told Reuters.

"We should also have the second half seasonal lift," Hanna said. Earlier Email reported a pre-abnormal net profit of A$27.26 million for the first half to September 30, up from A$24.83 million the previous corresponding half a year earlier.
Net profit however fell to A$23.85 million from A$26.61 million the previous year, due largely to abnormal losses of A$3.41 million incurred in reducing overheads.
